## RFP Scout
Finds new federal software notices, reads each one, and tells the bid team which are worth chasing.

**Credentials to attach:** SAM.gov API key (query auth, param `api_key`), Anthropic key (header auth, `x-api-key`), Google Sheets, Gmail.

## Why the validation step exists
The model answers through a forced tool call, then **Validate output** checks the schema, confirms every evidence quote really appears in the document, cross-checks the deadline against SAM.gov, and downgrades anything doubtful to *needs review*. A notice is only marked seen after a successful analysis, so failures retry on the next run.
